enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +15: Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Firestorm Lore +14: Passive: Your Fire and Lightning spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Firestorm +94: Passive: +94 Equipment bonus to Fire and Electric Spell Power.
Conjuration Focus +5: +5 Equipment bonus to the DC of Conjuration spells.
Evocation Focus +5: +5 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Arcane Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by two.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +1: +1 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
